verdict.rationale: Restate's source is publicly viewable on GitHub (restate-gh-1, restate-gh-2), suggesting openness, but a hands-on community comment explicitly disputes that Restate is truly open-licensed, stating BSL 'effectively prevents any meaningful dynamic functionality to be built on top of it without a commercial subscription' and calling the 'Open Source' label misleading (restate-comm-5). This is a concrete counter-example rather than general skepticism, so the claim of an open license is contradicted. Missing for 10: an official OSI-approved license file or docs statement, and any independent confirmation that the effective license is unrestricted.
